summary: The browser inference implementation has passed desktop Chromium tests, while physical Android, iPhone and Safari validation remains pending (a phone test build is published and collects reports). Behavioural validity rests on public data only; on real pet video (E18) the pet is found in about half of the clips. Required capabilities missing for cats (face, ears, tail, actions) and for dogs outside research (keypoints, actions) remain unresolved.

behavioral_model_validity.evidence: public data: E1, E1-CC, E2, E4, E7, E9-E18; real pet video with sound: E18 (Kinetics, 294 clips); semi-synthetic E8 and synthetic E5 are software checks, not evidence

key_results.breed_found_rate: cats 0.935, dogs 0.924 on breed photos; Sphynx 0.55, Newfoundland 0.71

blocking: cat face, ear, tail and action data
vocal type and dog context data (zenodo.org, huggingface.co blocked; terms)

on_device_compatibility_and_performance.evidence: desktop headless Chromium only; phone test build published at https://claude.ai/artifact/NRG1a19X1ZkPbgdigJGaf2 (version 4), no phone report yet
blocking: testers running the phone test on an iPhone (Safari) and an Android phone (Chrome)

complete_product_readiness.evidence: release profiles enforced by the exporter; asset terms recorded per artifact (docs/ASSET_TERMS.md)
blocking: Q-M2 (licence statement of the MediaPipe detector) or accept the phone build's lower dog recall
commercial: Q-T publisher decision or G1b
HTTPS origin under our control for the installed-app track (docs/DEVICE_TEST_PROTOCOL.md)

training_jobs.G1: data job and CPU toolchain smoke test done; GPU run pending
training_jobs.G2: annotation candidates and spec done; annotation pending
training_jobs.G4: cat context done (not shipped); dog context and vocal type blocked

decisions: The phone test build uses the licence-stated TF Hub detector; the MediaPipe detector is research-only until its licence statement is recorded (Q-M2). Measured cost: fewer dogs found on real video; measured benefit: faster in the browser on desktop.
The on-furniture relation ships as the pre-specified containment rule; the learned head was not better (E15 follow-up).
Dog keypoints and MammalNet-trained heads stay research-only (data terms).
Server analysis is opt-in; the default path never uploads media.
resources_needed: Run the phone test on one iPhone and one Android phone
Read the MediaPipe Object Detector Models page (Q-M2) and record its licence statement
Allow zenodo.org and huggingface.co (or provide the files)
One GPU (24 GB class, 4-8 h) for G1
Annotators for G2 (70-100 h for 2,000 cats + 2,000 dogs)
Household recordings: participants and a data controller (docs/household/CONSENT_AND_PRIVACY.md)
An HTTPS host with header control for the installed-app track (only after track A)
